caption:
Breakfast Egg Roll
easy and effortless breakfast recipe using leftover paratha / roti 

Nutrition: 
Macros: C: 46 | F: 29 | P: 30
Calories:  582 per serve
Serves 1

Ingredients
2 eggs + 1 egg white + salt + pepper
1 tsp oil 
1/2 onion, finely chopped 
1 green chilli, finely chopped 
1 cheese slice 
1 tbsp green chutney 
pickled onions + chilli
1 paratha / leftover roti
